license.scope: benchmark repository and its own files only; source PR repositories retain their own licenses

assets.role: full source PR manifest; not a labeled test partition
public development/test partition; not a blind holdout
human-reviewed findings; import only TP findings with introduced-by-pr scope, preserve original category/severity and exact line ranges

knownLimitations: Public labels are exposed and cannot be described as blind.
The 25-task test set is a development set, not a leaderboard-equivalent full evaluation.
TP-empty PRs are unlabeled for this adapter and must not be converted into clean negatives.
The corpus is cross-language and has limited direct embedded coverage; a FreeRTOS PR appears in the full corpus but not the 25-task test partition.

license.scope: benchmark repository; third-party source repository snapshots remain under original project licenses

assets.role: positive reference comments; blob content acquired and structurally audited; remains development-only and unimported pending label/anchor review
negative review-reference comments; not clean PR/code-change negatives

knownLimitations: Reference comments combine original review discussions and model-generated feedback followed by expert annotation; AI-generated and human discussion references must remain separately stratified.
The v1 positive asset contains 196 PR rows and 1,506 nested reference comments. It is acquired and structurally audited, but is not yet imported into Safe Core or used for model evaluation.
One of the 1,506 positive comments has a reversed from_line/to_line range; exclude or adjudicate it before any normalized evaluation import.

The 155-row negative_samples asset contains 639 nested review-reference comments with file paths and line anchors, but is not an independently adjudicated set of clean PRs; do not use it as a clean-negative denominator.

The repository README describes expert annotation of reference comments; this does not establish independent root-cause grouping, blind holdout status, or a Safe Core-specific true-positive label without a documented crosswalk.
Original third-party project licenses must be checked per source snapshot; no upstream source code or comment text is redistributed by this metadata-only audit.

snapshot.note: AACR-Bench Apache-2.0 repository license and both immutable asset blobs are pinned. Positive v1 JSON was acquired and structurally audited through the GitHub blob API; no raw comment text or source code is copied into Safe Core. The 196 PR / 1,506 reference comments remain not imported and are not used for model evaluation pending label crosswalk, root-cause adjudication, and original-project license review.

positiveAssetAcquisition.note: Exact immutable Git blob was fetched and parsed. Metadata-only structural audit; no comments or source code copied. One reversed line range remains excluded from normalized import.

negativeReferenceInspection.note: The nested comments contain paths and line anchors; however these are negative review-reference records, not adjudicated clean PRs.

positiveNegativePrOverlap.interpretation: Positive and negative comment-reference partitions overlap at PR level; 151 PRs appear in both. Therefore negative references are comment-level counterexamples within PRs, not clean-negative PR cases.

reviewBenchOverlap.note: No PR URL overlap was found between the 200-PR AACR v1 union and the 219-row ReviewBench manifest at the pinned revisions.
